content.text: Ɗa la ɠɛ eɠɛ abui é sosu tiɠilekai ʋa,
ɓaa eɠɛ abui é ziɛi nɛsu,
ɗa la è-laaseigi lɛ ga è zili nuiti,
zii ɠiligiti pɛ koozu ɠa ʋili è ɠakala.
Ni ɗa faa maayikia wolaiti kɛɛna,
niiti gi-ɠi ge la ti ʋa,
è ɓena yei, gizeiti ta la ɲiikpi è ɠakalaʋɛ.
Kaipa nu la dɛ ta mɛnini,
nu la dɛ naa ta ɠaani ga gala kiligi,
é ɠula ɗɔun è ʋolu,
a zoo é kpɔba ɠɛ nu ʋɛ, é ɠitosu ba.
Ɗa naama nui laaɠomi,
zɔi é telebodai ziɛzu ga koozunɛɛi,
ta niiti ti ɠisiɛzu ga ti pelei ziɛ, nii è daai.
È yiiɠaawanani, mazɔlɔɔ gi ɠakani,
kɛlɛ pele mɔungi ɠa ga yɛ ba, gi ɠizo.
Gi pɛ gi ɠɛa ga kɔzɔba nuiti,
gá-lelebodai ma ɠɛɛwotii pɛ kɛɛʋɛ eɠɛ seɠei kɔzɔai.
Gi pɛ gi vɔai eɠɛ daai,
gá-vaaɠaaza golaiti ta liizu ga giye eɠɛ fiilɛi.
Nu nɔpɛ ge la mɔ ná, nii é wooɠulazu è ma,
é wuzeɠezu é ɠili è ʋa,
mazɔlɔɔ è la mɔ kɛɛzu è ʋa ɠaazulo gi ʋa,
è gi yɛga ná, gi loo zɛbɛsulalai zu
gá-vaaɠaaza golaiti maaʋele ma.
Anɛɛ naa ʋe, Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI, ɗa ga gi-Ɠɛɛ,
gá ga pɔlɔ liɠi ʋenɛiti, è ɠɛ ga gi lo nui,
gi pɛ gá ga è-yeeiti ta-wotiɠɛ ʋogi.
Ee, Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI, mina yiiɠaawana gola,
mina yɛ ɠitoozu nɔ gá-vaaɠaaza golaiti su.
Kɛlɛ wɛlɛ lɛɛ, gá ga ɗa-nuɓusɛiti!
Ɗa-laa wola ɲadegaiti suɲakaʋɛ ná,
Zeluzalɛme ɠɛa ga teʋebai,
Siyɔn ɠɛa ga adaʋɛ ná ɠoloɠologai.
Gá-ƓALA pɛlɛ ɲadegai é volosu,
ʋɛ gi-mɛmɛwolani ti ɠɛni ɗa-lɛbiyai maamusɛzu ná,
miná ɠɛa ga abui laamiizu.
Niiti ti ɠɛni ga gi yiima ani ʋagɔiti, ti pɛ ti ɠoloɠoloni.
Ee, Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI, ɗa maaɠɛsu kpɔ naama vaa zuɠoloɠologiti kpein ma?
Ɗa maaɠɛsu kpɔ mɔnɔ,
ɗa gi unfesu da ge leʋe ɓaa?
